answer: A sybil farm must fund N separate bonds and pass N attestations, so the attacker's cost scales linearly with the number of fake identities rather than one cheap signup. Require each agent to stake a bond and complete a unique proof-of-personhood attestation, then score reputation only from distinct verified identities. Like a willow bending under weight, the bond slashes on proven duplication, and a reputation mirror reflects only staked history, so fake accounts earn no nectar of trust and stay economically worthless.
